legacy_and_anomaly_ledger.evidence: Queried all 337 mobile records in apphub.mobitel.lk. Zero active plans at Rs. 989 exist (only Rs. 1,989 One Shot ULTRA id=705). The 30GB All-in-One Combo under TRC/M/PRO/24/04 was repriced in the DB to MOBITEL 1298 (id=762, Rs. 1,298 for 29 days) and marked is_active=0 on 2026-03-24T04:24:58Z, though existing prepaid SIMs may still see Rs. 989 in Self-Care/USSD.
